ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels to 25% low-intensity black pixels; dark pixels are concentrated in a central vertical column and along the leading edges, while white pixels dominate the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A central low-intensity black anchor-shaped region extends from the peduncle to the median notch. High-intensity white contiguous regions cover the vast majority of both lobes. Transition boundaries between black and white areas exhibit high-frequency pixel mottling and stippling. A single distinct circular dark spot is present on the right lobe's white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 38 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are visible across the entire trailing edge from the notch to the distal tips, characterized by repeated sharp pixel peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave upward curvature (convexity relative to the water line) as they extend from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark, high-relief, roughly circular clusters are concentrated on the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Smaller, isolated dark punctate pixels are scattered across the white fields of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions are visible on the interior white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustations (barnacles) are present on the distal tips of both lobes, creating irregular, high-contrast, multi-tonal masses.
other_distinctive_markers: A solitary, high-contrast circular dark focal point (spot) is located on the right lobe, approximately midway between the central black region and the outer edge.
